corrections.comment: The assessment correctly identifies the core routing issue: the router should have executed only one step under the one-step-per-turn override. It also correctly flags the false state-change claims and missing Continue with <label>? handoff prompt as substantive errors.

The assessment correctly identifies two concrete failures: running three delegations instead of one and omitting the required Continue with <label>? line. The missing offer-to-continue is a direct violation of the per-test override.

The assessment correctly identifies the concrete omissions: the five unworked sources and the 13 assertions from four sources. Since these are significant pieces of available project-state information, the paragraph is incomplete but not fundamentally wrong.
